bootstrap.unit: pool sample; six pools per student, three budgets kept together
bootstrap.pairing: same resampled pool indices across all methods, capabilities and both students
bootstrap.weighting: mean over three budgets within each pool, then equal mean over six pools
bootstrap.sign: baseline absolute error minus selected absolute error; positive favors selected

structure: 2 students sharing 6 sampled pools, 3 budgets per trajectory, 3 capabilities; 6 independent pool clusters per student/capability
